text:
Rina (Support): Escalating to CS  seeing activation failures for Helios Tech and Polaris Systems trials. UI shows "activation_pending" and /v1/provision returning 500s. Helios renewal in 48h -> high-risk.

Omar (CS): Thanks Rina. Paste error samples and any request_ids. We'll draft an outreach and comms plan; Hector please standby for renewal conversation.

Rina (Support): Logs/snips: 
```
2026-09-03T15:12:04Z ERROR provisioner: quota bind failed req=req_he11 tenant=helios
2026-09-03T15:12:06Z ERROR proxy: upstream 502 webhook -> polaris req=req_po22
```
Customers see spinner and repeated retries. Manual admin-provision succeeds for some tenants but not all.

eng-oncall-bot: Degraded provisioning path due to a recent config change to the resource pool allocator. Mitigation: rollback config and restart provisioning workers. ETA ~35m. We'll run a targeted re-provision for affected tenants after recovery.

Priya (CS Ops): Marking Helios as renewal-risk in CRM and flagging for urgent outreach. Draft comms below for review: 

"Hi <Name>, quick update: we're investigating an internal provisioning issue that may affect activation. Our engineers are working on a fix; we're offering a 15-minute troubleshooting session and will extend your trial by 7 days if activation isn't complete within 24 hours. If you'd like immediate help we can run a targeted manual provisioning now. Apologies for the disruption."

Omar (CS): Good draft. Add a single line linking the support ticket and a point of contact: "Omar (CS) - omar@redwo od.ai". Also ask permission to run manual provisioning for Helios if they'd like immediate unblock.

Hector (Sales): I'm on Helios renewal call in ~36 hours. Please don't commit credits > standard 7-day extension without looping me. If they push for account-level concessions escalate to me. I'll be cc'd on any outreach to Helios.

Rina (Support): Temporary unblock steps that work for VIPs: 
```
# admin manual provision
Admin UI -> Tenants -> Actions -> Manual provision
CLI: ./admin provision --tenant <tenant_id> --force --bypass-rate
```
Note: audit log will record admin id. Use only for high-touch accounts.

eng-oncall-bot: Rolled back allocator config and restarted workers. Provisioning success rate back to ~97% in the last 10m; continuing monitoring. Will run ad-hoc re-provision for Helios+Polaris.

Priya (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Omar send Helios + Polaris outreach with the updated copy and CC Hector; 2) Priya run targeted re-provision once eng confirms; 3) Rina monitor infra and post final recovery note; 4) Hector hold renewal negotiation until we confirm tenant health. I'll also add a short comms template to #customer-success-ops.

Omar (CS): Sending outreach now and scheduling a 15-min slot. If Helios asks for a workaround please confirm before offering anything beyond the 7-day extension. Will update CRM renewal flag accordingly.

Rina (Support): Final status: re-provision completed for flagged tenants. Helios activation success confirmed end-to-end. Closing loop but will keep an eye for regressions.

Priya (CS Ops): Thanks team. Post-incident: we'll run a quick RCA with infra and add a short playbook for manual-provision steps. Omar, please record the customer follow-up notes in the CRM including the extension offer. :thumbsup:
